Save STABL Results to Disk

Source: R/exports.R
save_stabl_results.Rd

Writes STABL result artefacts into a single output directory. With the default what = "all" this is the complete set — stability scores, the list of selected features, the FDR diagnostic graph, the stability path plot, and per-feature distribution plots — and is the recommended way to persist and share results from a single stabl_fit() call. With what = "csv" only the tabular CSV exports are written.

Usage

save_stabl_results(
  object,
  path,
  x = NULL,
  y = NULL,
  figure_fmt = "pdf",
  new_hard_threshold = NULL,
  task_type = "binary",
  override = FALSE,
  what = c("all", "csv")
)

Arguments

object

A fitted "stabl_fit" object returned by stabl_fit().

path

Character string; path to the output directory. Created recursively if it does not already exist. When what = "all", raises an error if the directory exists and override = FALSE; when what = "csv", an existing directory is reused without error.

x

Numeric matrix of predictors used to fit object. Required when what = "all" (for per-feature distribution plots); must contain at least the selected feature columns. Ignored when what = "csv".

y

Outcome vector, factor, or survival::Surv object used to fit object. Required when what = "all"; ignored when what = "csv".

figure_fmt

Character; graphics device extension used when saving plots. Common choices: "pdf" (default, publication quality), "png", "svg".

new_hard_threshold

Numeric in (0, 1] or NULL. When supplied, overrides the stored threshold for support extraction and stability-path plotting.

task_type

Character; one of "binary" (default), "multiclass", or "regression". Determines which per-feature plot is generated: grouped boxplots for classification, LOESS scatter for regression.

override

Logical; if TRUE, an existing directory with the same path is accepted and its contents may be overwritten. Default FALSE. Only used when what = "all".

what

Character; "all" (default) for the complete result set including plots, or "csv" for the CSV tables only. The "csv" mode requires neither x/y nor a ggplot2 installation.

Value

Invisibly returns path as a normalised absolute string.

Details

With what = "all" the function orchestrates several lower-level helpers: the CSV export engine for tabular data, plot_fdr_graph() and plot_stabl_path() for diagnostic plots, and boxplot_features() or scatterplot_features() for per-feature distribution visualisations. All graphics are saved using ggplot2::ggsave() in the format specified by figure_fmt.

CSV files written (both modes):

  • STABL scores.csv — full p x L stability score matrix.

  • Max STABL scores.csv — per-feature maximum stability score, sorted descending.

  • STABL artificial scores.csv — artificial feature scores (only when artificial-feature scores are present, i.e. object$stabl_scores_artificial_ is not NULL).

  • Max STABL artificial scores.csv — artificial max scores, sorted descending (only when artificial features were used).

See also

plot_stabl_path(), plot_fdr_graph(), boxplot_features()

Examples

# \donttest{
set.seed(1L)
x <- matrix(rnorm(40 * 6), 40, 6,
             dimnames = list(paste0("s", 1:40), paste0("f", 1:6)))
y <- setNames(rnorm(40), rownames(x))
fit <- stabl_fit(x, y,
                 lambda_grid  = data.frame(lambda = c(0.3, 0.1, 0.05)),
                 n_bootstraps = 6L, hard_threshold = 0.3, random_state = 1L)

# CSV tables only (no ggplot2 required)
out_csv <- file.path(tempdir(), "stabl_csv_export")
save_stabl_results(fit, out_csv, what = "csv")
list.files(out_csv)
#> [1] "Max STABL artificial scores.csv" "Max STABL scores.csv"           
#> [3] "STABL artificial scores.csv"     "STABL scores.csv"               

# Complete result set
if (requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
  out_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "stabl_results")
  save_stabl_results(fit, out_dir, x = x, y = y,
                     task_type = "regression", figure_fmt = "png")
  list.files(out_dir)
}
#> [1] "FDR Graph.png"                   "Max STABL artificial scores.csv"
#> [3] "Max STABL scores.csv"            "STABL artificial scores.csv"    
#> [5] "STABL scores.csv"                "Selected Features"              
#> [7] "Stability Path.png"             
# }
